item.title: Big Adani stocks Q2 comparison: Adani Ports vs Adani Power vs Adani Green Energy shares; Who delivered beyond estimates?
item.description: Adani Power and Adani Green beat second-quarter FY27 estimates, while Adani Ports reported results broadly in line. Ports offered the strongest outlook, raising its FY27 EBITDA target to ₹26,000–27,000 crore, supported by rising cargo volumes and a healthy debt ratio.

item.title: Ola Electric stock jumps 11% in week; rights issue fully subscribed ahead of closing date - Check key details
item.description: Ola Electric shares rose 4.95% to ₹36.68 on Wednesday, extending a two-session winning streak and gaining about 11% in a week. The company’s ₹1,000-crore rights issue was fully subscribed, with 37.13 crore shares subscribed against 37.02 crore offered.

item.title: Crompton Greaves shares rebound 4% after recent losses: Can the beaten-down stock sustain its recovery?
item.description: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals shares rose 4% to ₹204. Choice Equity Broking sees scope for a recovery toward ₹230, citing support at ₹190– ₹200 and improving technical indicators. Other brokerages maintain Buy ratings with targets of ₹275– ₹300.

item.title: 67% rally in 6 months, 14% crash in a week: What changed for this jewellery stock under ₹50? Do you own it?
item.description: PC Jeweller shares fell for a fifth consecutive session, losing nearly 14% in a week after reaching a 52-week high. The pullback follows a 67% six-month rally and appears driven by profit-taking, despite the company reporting a 58% annual rise in second-quarter net profit.

item.title: Vedanta vs Vedanta Aluminium Q2 results 2026 compared: Profit, revenue, EBITDA and debt explained of Anil Agarwal firms
item.description: Vedanta Limited and Vedanta Aluminium both more than doubled their net profits in Q2FY27. Vedanta earned ₹3,650 crore, while VAML reported ₹5,167 crore. Higher commodity prices and production supported results, and both companies reduced debt.

item.title: 3400% rally in 5 years! Can this defence multibagger stock extend gains after Q2 results? Here’s what Systematix says
item.description: Apollo Micro Systems posted a strong quarterly performance, with revenue up 72.2% and net profit up 55.6% year on year. Systematix kept its Buy call and ₹570 target, citing growth prospects and an expected ₹120 billion in order inflows over two years.&nbsp;

item.title: Ramky Infrastructure shares surge over 17% to ₹300 despite a 46% yearly fall; what explains the sharp rebound?
item.description: Ramky Infrastructure shares jumped 17.4% to ₹300, their biggest single-day gain since August 2022, as trading volumes surged to nearly five times the weekly average. Despite the rebound, the stock remains down 46% in 2026 and about 70% from its record high.

item.title: Auto biggies Q2 result compared: Bajaj Auto vs Maruti Suzuki - Who wins the earnings race? Profit, revenue, target price
item.description: Bajaj Auto and Maruti Suzuki shares rose after quarterly results. Bajaj Auto’s profit increased 35.2% and revenue grew 34%, while Maruti Suzuki’s profit fell 26.4% amid higher costs despite a 26% revenue increase and record vehicle sales.

item.title: IndiaMART management expects profitable growth despite macro headwinds; AI could drive the next phase
item.description: IndiaMART CEO Dinesh Agarwal expects profitable growth despite stagnant subscriber volumes, citing an 8% rise in value per subscriber, technology investment, customer acquisition and category-based pricing. AI presents opportunities to improve efficiency as well as challenges to traffic discovery.

Its revised base-case target is ₹16, implying 34% upside, with recovery dependent on network investment and subscriber growth.

item.title: US Fed rate decision today: What investors should watch in gold, silver prices and market outlook
